column1: # Source: written for this pack (GPL-3.0-or-later). The sources of some constraint-* rows are single words or two-word phrases that occur in the Irish Wikipedia (CC BY-SA 4.0) or UD Irish-IDT (CC BY-SA 3.0); no text is copied. Expected traces are this pack's transform ids, newest first.
# Test files run with every optional processor on (addMissingFada), so the negatives leave out words that processor reads as another word; those are in defaults.tsv.

# Constraint rows: each fails when one stem constraint of the named transform is deleted (README.md, Measurements 6). Most sources are words or two-word phrases of the Irish Wikipedia or UD Irish-IDT; the rest are built from the rule's ending.
